name: job-tracker
description: Job application tracker with a Node.js/Express API, Next.js frontend and MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:memory -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
